source.name: RoboLibrary — Cameraman Tower Defense Units
source.method: Figures read from in-game stat cards in two independent recordings; only units where both readings agree are listed as verified.

scientist-cameraman.note: Economy unit: about 500 cash per wave at max. Four copies pay roughly 2,000 per wave.

large-cameraman.note: Cheap and reliable in the early waves.

ninja-cameraman.note: Best damage per cash of any measured unit.

camera-helicopter.note: Spawner: summons allies up to 10,000 HP. Blockers, not damage.

engineer-cameraman.note: Spawner: allies hit about 3,000 DPS with 100,000 HP, one every ~20s. Deals no damage until maxed.

laser-cameraman-car.note: The final upgrade is where the damage is.

large-tv-man.note: Area damage; community reports a shield problem.

titan-cameraman.note: Final upgrade doubles damage. Readings put max DPS at 3,000-3,300.

tv-man.note: Area damage; community reports a shield problem.

upgraded-titan-speakerman.note: Area damage; handles shields at max.

upgraded-titan-tv-man.note: Card reading: 1,500 coins to place, listed 30,000 DPS at range 20, maximum single-hit damage 36,000 on a 3-second cooldown. Community damage panels report 18,000 DPS in-match (10,500 TV attack + 7,500 core attack), which is below the card figure.

upgraded-brute-prototype.note: Single-source report: about 9,000 area DPS, roughly 41,000 cash to max. No graded card reading.

upgraded-videotapper-prototype.note: Single-source report: about 7,500 DPS at 35 range; final upgrade doubles attack speed rather than damage.

tv-spider.note: Single-source report: about 10,000 area DPS at 40 range, the highest damage number in the game.

glitch-cameraman.note: Lobby card reports 27 range, in-match card maxes at 25. Final upgrade reportedly triples damage.
